details:
EXPLORE THE UNIVERSE – VISIT EARTH – MEET SKYNET

PART 1

To tell a good story about the discarded rovers on distant planets we have to tell a good story about NASA, their Creator. The mission of NASA is to Explore the Universe, to leave ground against gravity and go up to space. From space no other choice just to revisit Earth or go to visit another Earth. Our Project name is Visit Earth! to emphasize that in our explorations we cannot leave behind Earth’s general problems, we carry them with us wherever we go.

PART 2

So we have to put together and organize, to project and to reconstruct everything that’s related to this physical, metaphysical and inter-personal (political) POWER CENTER: Meet Skynet! as a very new and very ancient VISION, a mission-Vision.

Could be presented as optional and could be presented as necessary.

Not everybody can travel to space, but everybody can be part of our Visit Earth! and Meet Skynet! movement, in a soul-employment projection.

This way, silently we can present our best-behave POVs and attitudes, to be compared with the modern worst-behave and fake paper-tiger, inefficient leaders:

- the nature of the organizational power-center is to be empty as the “visible” space-in-the-sky, not always populated (Putin)

- leadership is assumed and essential but transitional, takes a lot of effort and proper Vision, and should not be associated with comfort (Trump)

- when his mission is finished a true visionary leader will naturally leave the position, have to come back to Earth, to the common ground (Musk)

OUR STORY

If with this Visit Earth! approach and vision-mission we can revive an ancient story like Plato's Cave Analogy, in time we can surely bring back to life NASA's sleeping rovers on distant planets, or at least tell a good story about them when we put them to rest, at their funeral!

So, now you know, our story is a reverse flow, awaiting creation story, because from the distant local level we cannot directly and suddenly create this center-based shiny and pulsating Crystal Network.

This is true for every person living currently on Earth, in transition somewhere in Outer Space or living on another Planet in a distant galaxy.

As a consequence, with good heart right now we cannot tell a proper story about discarded rovers on distant planets, before we have clarity regarding our global Power Center organizations.

NASA as one of this global Power Center organizations can react to our approach and implement it properly.

If you present in due time your carefully considered Proposal regarding the first steps we should follow, we will let you know in due time if you have our permission to proceed.

"NASA’s Visit Earth! project successfully reminded us about a new but also very ancient way to finally land on the Blue Planet and deliver the first-ever Crystal Access Intelligence Network as an Organizational Center, with revelatory synchronicity and amazing symphonicity."
